recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for R6. If separate AllergyIntolerance terminology artifact maturity changes are desired, they should be handled as separate terminology-artifact decisions rather than broadening this resource-level Jira.
issue_request: FHIR-32050 asked to update AllergyIntolerance's FHIR Maturity Level to Normative. Jira is Applied/Persuasive, with Applied for Version R6 and a 2026-03-26 Patient Care vote, and its resolution cites the September 2025 Patient Care WGM decision that AllergyIntolerance is planned to go normative in R6.
initial_application: There was no prior combined-branch commit with Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-32050 and no FHIR-32050-tagged source commit was found. Earlier history partially applied the decision: b0795b968d removed trial-use markings from AllergyIntolerance.type and AllergyIntolerance.reaction, and 5c20769cc7 changed the AllergyIntolerance StructureDefinition standards-status to normative, but source/fhir.ini and the StructureDefinition fmm extension still said 3.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is listed as an active resource in source/fhir.ini and has FMG approval. FHIR versions.html defines FMM 6 as synonymous with normative standards status. The September 2025 Patient Care WGM minutes record discussion of AllergyIntolerance in the normative-resource set and a 31-0-1 motion supporting the documented feedback to FMG. Zulip discussion also supported the expectation that AllergyIntolerance would be normative in R6 and that Patient Care could resolve old maturity comments based on the intended normative direction.
reconciliation: Updated source/fhir.ini and source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml so the active AllergyIntolerance resource FMM metadata is 6, matching the already normative standards-status and the Jira resolution. No terminology artifacts or generated outputs were edited because the issue is specifically resource-level maturity.
source_changes: source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml: changed the top-level structuredefinition-fmm valueInteger from 3 to 6.
